description: This file defines a test module for dependency injection in a Kotlin project using Dagger Hilt. It provides mock or stub implementations for synchronization-related components, replacing actual production implementations during testing.

classes.name: TestSyncModule
classes.description: A Dagger module used specifically for testing, replacing the production SyncModule and providing stub implementations for SyncManager and SyncSubscriber.

methods.name: bindsSyncStatusMonitor
methods.description: Binds a stub implementation of SyncManager (NeverSyncingSyncManager) for testing purposes.

methods.name: bindsSyncSubscriber
methods.description: Binds a stub implementation (StubSyncSubscriber) for the SyncSubscriber interface.
